description: Use for natural photo requests such as What records are these?, Tell me about this collection, Which pressing is this?, Play these, or Make me a playlist from this photo. The user does not need to name a tool or transcribe the image. Identify music in a user-attached album cover, several covers or shelf spines, vinyl/CD label, tracklist screenshot or concert poster. Returns observed text, uncertain details, song identities or album release choices for review. Does not generate a show, save a file or start playback. For a tracklist, use confirmed tracks with make_playable experience=media. For photo-to-playlist requests, identify the attached image first, pass each identified album title in make_playable tracks[].album or catalog mediaItems[].album so the server enforces album membership, then build a clearly labeled sampler across the confidently identified albums unless complete albums or specific songs were requested. Do not require confirmation for obvious identities. If a model-selected song cannot resolve, try one verified alternative from the same album before asking the user; preserve exact user-selected songs and report remaining gaps. Explain unresolved albums before offering a partial sampler; report readiness only for the returned queue. For an album, confirm the release before making an album story. For a poster, confirm the artists and ask what listening experience is wanted. Cover artwork alone does not establish a physical pressing or exact edition. If an attachment URL expires, ask for the file again rather than inferring its contents.
name: identify_image
title: Identify music in an image
